sections.title: In honor *of James*

image.alt: A SunBreak installer fitting film to a car window

body: Brothers Gene and James Hart grew up with a love for cars. James was one of the best tinters in the country until he passed away in 2019, and Gene carries on the family tradition with SunBreak in his honor and memory.
Our mission is simple: timely, value-enhancing window tinting for cars, homes and businesses, in a clean, friendly shop, with professionalism, excellence and timeliness on every job.

items.q: What’s the difference with ceramic tint?
items.a: Ceramic film uses non-metallic particles, so it rejects more heat, cuts more glare and lasts longer than dyed or carbon film, without interfering with phone, GPS, radio or keyless entry.
High-quality ceramic film can last 10 years or more with professional installation and care, and is often backed by a manufacturer’s warranty.

items.q: Do you tint homes and businesses too?
items.a: Yes: solar, security, privacy and decorative film for homes, offices and storefronts.
Walk-ins are welcome at both shops. Call for a free, no-obligation estimate on bigger projects.
